newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis does not fear market reaction on election.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis does not fear market reaction on election.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Monday he did not fear a negative market reaction to a possible early general election in France.
Asked by Reuters Financial Television if he was worried that the markets would be rattled by an election call, Arthuis replied "No".

He said the markets would be reassured by the fact that France had "chosen the way to create jobs through less public expenditure and lower public deficits." He was speaking after a news conference to announce the design of the French euro coin.
